18jobs:

20 name: ${{ matrix.os }} / Python ${{ matrix.python }} / full, permissions, package

24 fail-fast: false

45 enable-cache: false
46 - name: Minimal Linux Qt offscreen dynamic libraries (no desktop or display service)
47 if: runner.os == 'Linux'
48 run: |
49 sudo apt-get update
50 sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libegl1 libopengl0 fonts-noto-cjk
51 - name: Clean environment from frozen uv.lock (includes declared native test dependencies)
52 id: prepare
53 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py prepare --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
54 - name: Authorization AST and governance read-side gates; Git whitespace
55 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py static --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
56 - name: Host configuration, process and network isolation sentinels
57 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py test --suite isolation --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
58 - name: Cross-platform Git, child isolation, request privacy and unsupported-backend regression
59 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py test --suite portability --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
60 - name: Full pytest without ignored modules; coverage at least 75 percent
61 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py test --suite full --cov-fail-under "${{ env.COV_FLOOR }}" --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
62 - name: High-risk remediation regression (including real loopback listeners)
63 if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' }}
64 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py test --suite high-risk --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
65 - name: Platform APIs, approval/artifact contracts, fail-closed and model smoke safety
66 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py test --suite platform --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
67 - name: Twelve Web pages in existing Edge or Chrome; real API and SSE
68 run: python -B scripts/platform_ci.py browser --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
69 - name: Python syntax, public path, secret and fixed-demo-data scan
70 run: python -B scripts/platform_ci.py scan --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
71 - name: R02 real POSIX permissions; non-root; umask 022; no skipped cases
72 if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' && runner.os == 'Linux' }}
73 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py test --suite posix --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
74 - name: Wheel and sdist; external clean base installation; Windows optional entry prechecks
75 if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' }}
76 run: python -B scripts/ci_verify.py package --output-dir "${{ runner.temp }}/pyharness-ci"
